fields.label: Exact supplier product name
fields.question: What is the exact product name of this model in your catalogue?

fields.label: Supplier official SKU / reference
fields.question: What is your official SKU or article number for this model?

fields.label: Product type (infrared cabin or traditional sauna with stove)
fields.question: Is this model an infrared cabin or a traditional sauna with an electric stove? Answer 'infrared' or 'traditional'.

fields.label: Exterior width x depth x height (cm)
fields.question: Exact exterior dimensions width x depth x height in cm.

fields.label: Net weight (kg)
fields.question: Net weight of the assembled cabin in kg.

fields.label: Packaged shipping weight (kg) and number of packages
fields.question: Gross shipping weight in kg, number of packages and size of each package.

fields.label: Maximum number of users / seats
fields.question: Maximum number of persons the manufacturer allows.

fields.label: Exact wood species and materials
fields.question: Exact wood species for walls, bench and interior (e.g. spruce, hemlock, red cedar, oak) and all other materials. Is any part actually oak?

fields.label: Glass type, safety glass and thickness (mm)
fields.question: Glass type of door and front. Is it tempered safety glass (ESG)? Thickness in mm?

fields.label: Heater type and manufacturer
fields.question: Type of heater (e.g. carbon infrared panels, ceramic emitters, electric sauna stove), number of heaters and heater manufacturer.
fields.documents: Datasheet and heater rating plate photo

fields.label: Total rated heating power (W)
fields.question: Total rated heating power in watts as printed on the rating plate.

fields.label: Electrical requirements
fields.question: Voltage, phases, rated current (A), required fuse, plug type (e.g. Schuko), cable length, and whether a fixed connection by an electrician is required.
fields.documents: Datasheet, manual and rating plate photo

fields.label: Package contents
fields.question: Complete list of package contents: cabin panels, heater, controller, cables, lighting, bench, accessories, manual (language?).

fields.label: Assembly method, tools and time
fields.question: Flat-pack or preassembled? Required tools, number of persons and estimated assembly time.

fields.label: Certifications and supporting documents (CE)
fields.question: Which certifications apply (CE marking and directives, e.g. LVD 2014/35/EU, EMC 2014/30/EU, RoHS 2011/65/EU)? Please send the EU Declaration of Conformity and test reports (e.g. EN 60335-1 and EN 60335-2-53).
fields.documents: EU Declaration of Conformity and test reports

fields.label: Warranty duration
fields.question: Do you grant a 10-year warranty for this exact model? If not, what duration?

fields.label: Warranty scope
fields.question: Which parts are covered (wood, heater, glass, electronics) and for how long each?

fields.label: Warranty exclusions
fields.question: What is excluded from the warranty?

fields.label: Warranty provider and claim procedure
fields.question: Who is the warranty provider (company name and address) and how does an end customer in Germany make a claim?

fields.label: Supplier-confirmed stock and availability
fields.question: How many units can you supply now, and what is the restock lead time?

fields.label: Units held by the shop
fields.documents: Stock count by the shop owner

fields.label: Delivery estimate within Germany
fields.question: Which carrier delivers and in how many working days? Curbside or to the door?

fields.label: Manufacturer name, postal and electronic address (GPSR Art. 19)
fields.question: Manufacturer company name, postal address and email address as printed on the product or packaging.
fields.documents: Rating plate or packaging label photo

fields.label: EU responsible person if manufacturer is outside the EU (GPSR)
fields.question: If the manufacturer is outside the EU: name, postal and email address of the responsible economic operator in the EU.

fields.label: Safety warnings and manual in German
fields.question: Please send the user manual and safety warnings in German (PDF).
